business.title: Open a job position
business.goal: Create an open position with its hiring requirements.

steps.title: Enter the position title, department, description, and headcount.
steps.description: Create the job position with its title, department, description, and required headcount.

outcome.statement: An open job position is available for candidate applications.
evidence: The job position shows its title, department, description, and headcount.
The job position is available in the hiring pipeline.

business.title: Register a candidate
business.goal: Add a candidate to the hiring pipeline.

steps.title: Capture candidate details.
steps.description: Register the candidate's name, email, resume link, and source.

outcome.statement: The candidate is available to be considered for job positions.
evidence: The candidate record shows the name, email, resume link, and source.

business.title: Start candidate screening
business.goal: Record a candidate's application for an open job position and begin screening.

steps.title: Find the candidate.
steps.description: Locate the registered candidate, or use the candidate already in context.

steps.title: Find the open position.
steps.description: Locate the open job position for the application.

steps.title: Create the application.
steps.description: Record the candidate's application for the selected job position in screening.

outcome.statement: The candidate has an application in the screening stage for the job position.
evidence: An application links the candidate and job position.
The application shows the screening stage.

business.title: Advance an application to interview
business.goal: Move a screened application to the interview stage.

steps.title: Find the application.
steps.description: Locate the application, or use the application already in context.

steps.title: Review screening details.
steps.description: Inspect the application and its current screening stage.

steps.title: Move the application to interview.
steps.description: Advance the application from screening to interview.

outcome.statement: The application is ready for the interview stage.
evidence: The application shows the interview stage.

business.title: Decide and issue an offer
business.goal: Authorize an offer for an interviewed candidate.

steps.title: Find the interviewed application.
steps.description: Locate the application, or use the application already in context.

steps.title: Review the application.
steps.description: Inspect the candidate, job position, and interview-stage application.

steps.title: Decide whether to authorize an offer.
steps.description: Choose to authorize an offer for the interviewed candidate.

steps.title: Issue the offer.
steps.description: Move the application from interview to offer.

outcome.statement: The selected application has an authorized offer.
evidence: The application shows the offer stage.
The application remains linked to the candidate and job position.

business.title: Decide and record a hire
business.goal: Confirm that a candidate with an offer is hired.

steps.title: Find the application with an offer.
steps.description: Locate the application, or use the application already in context.

steps.title: Review the offer application.
steps.description: Inspect the candidate, job position, and offer-stage application.

steps.title: Review position capacity.
steps.description: Inspect the position's remaining headcount before confirming the hire.

steps.title: Decide whether to hire the candidate.
steps.description: Choose to confirm the candidate as hired.

steps.title: Record the hire.
steps.description: Move the application from offer to hired and update the position's filled headcount.

outcome.statement: The candidate is recorded as hired, and the job position reflects the filled headcount.
evidence: The application shows the hired stage.
The job position's filled headcount reflects the hire.
A position whose headcount is filled is closed automatically.

business.title: Reject an application
business.goal: Record that a candidate will not continue in the hiring pipeline.

steps.title: Find the application.
steps.description: Locate the active application, or use the application already in context.

steps.title: Record the rejection reason.
steps.description: Move the application to rejected and record the reason for rejection.

outcome.statement: The application is rejected with a recorded reason.
evidence: The application shows the rejected stage.
The application includes a rejection reason.
